newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting limited inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 100 slaughter steers and 100 heifers; 79,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 15,000 formulated cattle and 1,900 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 69.00.
Wk to Date - 79,300 Week Ago - 88,300 Year Ago - 59,800
